job.job_description:
React + Azure Databricks Developer

We are seeking a skilled React + Azure Databricks experienced resource to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in React.js, Python, Azure Databricks, and cloud technologies, with the ability to build responsive user interfaces, develop backend services, and create efficient data processing pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React.js.
Build and optimize data processing solutions using Azure Databricks and PySpark.
Develop backend services, APIs, and automation scripts using Python.
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and cloud data platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable business solutions.
Ensure application performance, security, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and support activities.

Required Skills

Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Proficiency in Python for application development, scripting, and data processing.
Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, PySpark, and Azure cloud services.
Experience with REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of data engineering, cloud architecture, and system integration.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Knowledge of SQL and data modeling concepts.

Experience: 6+ years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai

Willing to work on shifts 6.30 AM 3.30 PM & 1.30 PM 10.30 PM
